### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines?

### 2.0 Include experiment matrix

- Let's first include the reactivity gene expression matrix and the supplied experiment matrix.

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

experiment_matrix_df <- data.table::fread("01-erap2-overexpression-alignments/input_files/nfcore_sampleinfo.csv", data.table = F)
experiment_matrix_df$ERAP <- str_split(experiment_matrix_df$sample, pattern = "_", simplify = T)[,2]
experiment_matrix_df$replicate <- str_split(experiment_matrix_df$sample, pattern = "_", simplify = T)[,1]
experiment_matrix_df$ERAP <- factor(experiment_matrix_df$ERAP, levels = c("Un", "ssGFP", "ERAP2"))
experiment_matrix_df <- unique(experiment_matrix_df[,c("sample","ERAP")])

```

### 3.0 Perform differential expression profiling

- Import counts matrix

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

gene_expression_matrix <- read.table("01-erap2-overexpression-alignments/nfcore/star_rsem/rsem.merged.gene_counts.tsv", header = T)
rownames(gene_expression_matrix) <- gene_expression_matrix[,1]
gene_expression_matrix <- gene_expression_matrix[,match(experiment_matrix_df$sample, colnames(gene_expression_matrix))]

```

- Perform differential expression profiling in whole cells 

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(gene_expression_matrix),
    colData = experiment_matrix_df,
    design = ~ ERAP)
de_object <- DESeq(dds)
dds_vst <- assay(vst(dds))

de_object_erap2_ssgfp_ctrl <- results(de_object, contrast = c("ERAP", "ssGFP", "Un"))

de_object_erap2_vs_un <- results(de_object, contrast = c("ERAP", "ERAP2", "Un"))

de_object_effect_of_erap2 <- results(de_object, contrast = list("ERAP_ERAP2_vs_Un", "ERAP_ssGFP_vs_Un"))

all_de_object_list <- list(
    "ssgfp_overexpression" = de_object_erap2_ssgfp_ctrl,
    "erap2_vs_untx" = de_object_erap2_vs_un,
    "erap2_overexpression_effect" = de_object_effect_of_erap2)

saveRDS(object = list(vst_matrix = dds_vst, 
    differential_object = de_object,
    contrasts = all_de_object_list),
    file = file.path(rdata_dir, "01-erap2-overexpression-differentially-expressed-objects.rds"))

```

### 4.0 Perform PCA analysis

- Perform Plot of deseq2 object 


```{r fig.cap = "PCA plot of DESeq2 samples differentially expressed genes", include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}


# rownames(dds_vst) <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(dds_vst), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
pca_object <- pca(dds_vst, metadata = colData(dds), removeVar = 0.1)

new_names <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(pca_object$loadings), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
duplicated_names <- new_names[new_names %in% new_names[duplicated(new_names)]]
new_names[is.na(new_names) | new_names %in% duplicated_names] <- rownames(pca_object$loadings)[is.na(new_names) | new_names %in% duplicated_names ]

rownames(pca_object$loadings) <- new_names


pdf("02-01-differential-expression-profiling/plots/01-erap2-overexpression-pca_plot.pdf")
  biplot(pca_object, showLoadings = FALSE,
    # labSize = 3, 
    pointSize = 3, 
    # sizeLoadingsNames = 3,
    colby = "ERAP",
    legendPosition = "bottom",
    hline = 0,
    vline = 0)
dev.off()

```


### 5.0 Make volcano plot

- Plot volcano plot

```{r}


all_de_objects_list <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "01-erap2-overexpression-differentially-expressed-objects.rds"))
de_analysis_list <- all_de_objects_list$contrasts
de_object <- all_de_objects_list$differential_object

all_de_df_list <- lapply(names(de_analysis_list), function(x){
    message(x)
    a_de_object <- de_analysis_list[[x]]
    filter <- !is.na(a_de_object$padj)
    logfcs <- a_de_object$log2FoldChange[filter]

    data.frame(contrasts = x, 
        gene_ids = rownames(a_de_object)[filter],
        logfc = logfcs,
        pval = a_de_object$pvalue[filter],
        padj = a_de_object$padj[filter])
})
all_de_df <- do.call(rbind, all_de_df_list)

saveRDS(object = all_de_df, file = file.path(rdata_dir, "01-all-differentially-expressed-genes.RDS"))

de_df_list <- lapply(names(de_analysis_list), function(x){
    message(x)
    a_de_object <- de_analysis_list[[x]]
    filter <- a_de_object$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(a_de_object$padj)
    logfcs <- a_de_object$log2FoldChange[filter]
    # if(!is.na(contrast_ref_df$reference_names[contrast_ref_df$contrast_names == x])){
    #     ref_name <- contrast_ref_df$reference_names[contrast_ref_df$contrast_names == x]
    #     ref_lfcs <- de_analysis_list[[ref_name]]$log2FoldChange[filter]
    #     logfcs <- ref_lfcs - a_de_object$log2FoldChange[filter]
    # }
    if(any(filter)){
        return(data.frame(contrasts = x, 
                gene_ids = rownames(a_de_object)[filter],
                logfc = logfcs,
                pval = a_de_object$pvalue[filter],
                padj = a_de_object$padj[filter]))

})
de_df <- do.call(rbind, de_df_list)

de_df$gene_name <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(de_df$gene_ids, annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
all_de_df$gene_name <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(all_de_df$gene_ids, annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
```

- Select genes affected by ERAP2 overexpression 


```{r}

de_df$direction <- ifelse(de_df$logfc < 0, "down", "up")
de_df$temp_id <- paste(de_df$gene_id, de_df$direction)

gene_split <- split(de_df$temp_id, de_df$contrasts)
erap2_affected_genes <- setdiff(gene_split[["erap2_vs_untx"]], gene_split[["ssgfp_overexpression"]])

erap2_affected_de_df <- de_df[de_df$temp_id %in% erap2_affected_genes & de_df$contrasts == "erap2_vs_untx",]

```

- Perform gene set enrichment

```{r}

library("enrichR")
dbs <- "GO_Biological_Process_2023"
directions <- c("up", "down")

contrast_split <- split(erap2_affected_de_df, erap2_affected_de_df$direction)
enrichment_result_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(contrast_split, function(temp_df){
    db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
        current_genes <- temp_df$gene_name[!is.na(temp_df$gene_name)]
        an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
        if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
            return(NULL)
        }
        an_enrichment_df$direction <- unique(temp_df$direction)
        an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
        an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
        Sys.sleep(5)
        return(an_enrichment_df)
    })
    db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
}))
enrichment_result_df$gene_ratio <- vapply(enrichment_result_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)

write.csv(x = enrichment_result_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "05-ERAP2-overexpression-ERAP2-vs-Untx-remove-ssGFP-significantly-differentially-expressed-genes-padj-less-than-0.05.csv"),
    row.names = F, quote = F)

#significant_gene_set_enrichment <- enrichment_result_df[enrichment_result_df$P.value < 0.05 & enrichment_result_df$gene_ratio > 0.1,]

```
